Class PetriIdGenerator

java.lang.Object
ua.stetsenkoinna.petriobj.PetriIdGenerator
public class PetriIdGenerator extends Object
Generator for unique human-readable IDs for Petri net elements. Follows PNML standards (ISO/IEC 15909) and XML NCName rules. ID format: {prefix}-{sanitized_name}-{short_uuid} Example: p-buffer-a3f2, t-process-b9e1, arc-4d7c
Author:
PetriObjPaint Team
